status: baseline reviewed; final workflow waiting for source freeze

findings.gap: Normal completion aborts/releases the scene lease. The host hides the pooled actor and restores camera/input/HUD, producing the apparent return to game inside the preview. No navigation is required for this symptom.
findings.acceptance: Authoring preview retains last sampled frame and scene/input/HUD ownership; explicit stop/interruption and normal game completion still release.

findings.gap: Completed playback is not seekable, polling does not publish final cursor time, and replay causes a load path.
findings.acceptance: End/start/seek/replay work after retained completion, show exact current time and reuse existing prepared actors.

findings.gap: A native drag at a later time changes the base actor transform if no transform track exists. It does not create the requested start0→later-time path.
findings.acceptance: Record a zero-time start before later point; native drag at2s creates or updates that actor’s key without changing independent actors.

findings.gap: Baseline exposes a key insertion in advanced controls but no primary path-point list, visible route/points, timing edit/delete or quarter checkpoints.
findings.acceptance: Users can create, inspect, retime and remove path points using visible controls;0/25/50/75/100% samples match the runtime evaluator.

findings.gap: Strict version1 currently has no orientToPath or actor-follow camera fields.
findings.acceptance: Optional new fields validate/evaluate consistently while legacy version1 documents retain their exact previous behavior.

stages.name: Contract and legacy data
checkpoints: Preview-only retainOnComplete with normal-game default release.
Optional orientToPath and shot lookAtActorId/lookAtOffset are strict, bounded and backward compatible.

stages.name: Actual cold authoring entry
checkpoints: Studio DOM→native transport→exact main readiness→actual createWorld/BossBattle/default scoped loader/host.
Only model/image fetch boundary fixtures; no fake host, preparation, readiness or direct observable pointer delivery.

stages.name: Independent actor paths
checkpoints: Start at0, select2s, real canvas DOM drag, save point; repeat for another actor.
Point list, retime/delete/undo/redo and visible-line toggle have coherent ownership/cleanup.

stages.name: Runtime quarter comparisons
checkpoints: Compare0/25/50/75/100% local values and native actor world transforms to independent interpolation.
Direction facing handles endpoints/repeated positions; rigid anchor conversion is correct.

stages.name: Motion and camera
checkpoints: Actual registered clips with edited ranges/blends/loop accompany path movement.
Multiple contiguous camera shots, transitions and actor follow match evaluator/native camera targets.

stages.name: Retained end and warm replay
checkpoints: Completion retains actors, final camera, input suspension, HUD/hero ownership and exact cursor.
Seek/replay works without model parses, new actor creation, skeleton/rebind/material clone increments.

stages.name: Save and game consumption
checkpoints: Immediate file-save after native edit includes pending changes; reopen exact document.
Browser save and explicit game-open consume identical document; ordinary game completion restores camera/input/HUD/hero.

stages.name: Explicit interruption
checkpoints: Stop/map/dispose/error from retained end releases exact ownership and path overlays.
Late work cannot mutate new map/document; cleanup leaves no owned scene observer/timer/path material growth.

scope: Read-only review of exact git baseline; acceptance gaps are source-backed. No final candidate workflow, browser automation, pixel/device/GPU measurement, build or deployment performed.
